title: Facades, Contracts aur Helper Functions
objectives: Facade kya hai aur andar se kaise kaam karta hai samajhna
Facade, helper aur dependency injection ka farak jaanna

sections.heading: Facade kya hai?
sections.body: Facade container mein bandi hui class ka **static jaisa interface** hai. `Cache::get('key')` dekhne mein static call lagti hai, par andar se Laravel container se asli `cache` object nikalta hai aur uska method chalata hai. Isse code chhota aur padhne mein aasan hota hai.

callout.text: Facade = shortcut. Piche asli object hai jo container se aata hai, isliye testing mein fake bhi ho sakta hai.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Cache ke teen tareeke
sections.body: Ek hi kaam teen tareeke se: Facade, helper aur dependency injection.
explain: Facade: chhota aur popular, controllers aur routes mein aam hai.
DI: dependency constructor/method mein saaf dikhti hai. `Illuminate\Contracts\...` ke interfaces ko **Contracts** kehte hain.

sections.heading: Facade andar se kaise kaam karta hai
sections.body: Har facade ek chhoti class hoti hai jo batati hai ki container mein kaunsi cheez maangni hai. Apna facade bana ke samjho:

code.code:
<?php

namespace App\Services;

class CartService
{
    public function total(): int
    {
        return 3097;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Facades;

use App\Services\CartService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Facade;

class Cart extends Facade
{
    protected static function getFacadeAccessor(): string
    {
        return CartService::class;
    }
}

explain: `getFacadeAccessor()` container ko batata hai ki kaunsi service resolve karni hai.
`Cart::total()` -> container se `CartService` ka object -> uska `total()` method.
`CartService` auto-resolve hoti hai, alag binding ki zarurat nahi.

sections.heading: Testing mein Facade fake karna
sections.body: Facade ka bada fayda testing hai: asli kaam ki jagah fake chalana.
explain: `Mail::fake()`, `Queue::fake()`, `Http::fake()` – asli email/job/HTTP call roke bina test chalate hain.

sections.heading: Facade ya DI?
sections.body:
Dono sahi hain. Thumb rule:

- Chhote kaam aur routes/controllers mein facade ya helper chalega.
- Badi classes (services) mein constructor injection se dependencies saaf dikhti hain.
- Facade ke saath dhyan rakho ki ek class mein bahut saare facades na bhar jaayein, class ka kaam badhta jaata hai.

versionDiff.heading: Facades: Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: Facades aur helpers teeno versions mein same kaam karte hain.

items.11: Facades `Illuminate\Support\Facades\...` namespace mein. Class file ke andar hamesha `use` likho.
items.13: Same. Koi breaking change nahi, facade code waise hi chalta hai.

errors.cause: Controller ya kisi namespaced class mein facade ka `use` nahi likha, to PHP usi namespace mein `Cache` dhundta hai.

errors.error: Facade does not implement getFacadeAccessor method
errors.fix: Method banao jo class ka naam ya container key return kare.

errors.error: Call to undefined method on facade
errors.cause: Jis class ke piche facade hai usme woh method hai hi nahi.
errors.fix: Facade ki asli class ki documentation/source dekho aur sahi method naam use karo.

debug.body: Facade ke piche kaunsi class hai Tinker se dekho.

options: Container ki class ka static-jaisa interface
quiz.why: Facade container ke object tak chhota static-jaisa raasta deta hai.

quiz.q: Custom facade mein kaunsa method zaroori hai?
quiz.why: `getFacadeAccessor()` batata hai ki container se kya resolve karna hai.

quiz.q: Namespaced class mein `Cache::get()` par 'Class not found' aaye to kya karein?
quiz.why: Facade ka `use` statement likhna padta hai.

interview.q: What is a Facade in Laravel?
interview.a: Container mein registered service ka static-jaisa proxy. Static call andar se container ke object ka method chalati hai.

interview.q: Facade aur helper function mein farak?
interview.a: Dono shortcut hain. Facade class-based hai (`Cache::get`), helper global function (`cache()`). Dono same underlying service use karte hain.
Kyunki piche container ka object hota hai, to `shouldReceive()` ya `fake()` se use mock kiya ja sakta hai.
`Illuminate\Contracts` ke interfaces jo framework services ka contract batate hain. DI mein type-hint karne ke liye use hote hain.

interview.q: Facade ya dependency injection kab use karein?
interview.a: Chhote kaam mein facade/helper theek hai. Badi classes mein DI se dependencies saaf dikhti hain.

summary: Facade container ki service ka static-jaisa shortcut hai.
Testing mein `shouldReceive()` aur `fake()` kaam aate hain.
Facade aur DI dono valid hain, jagah dekh kar chuno.
